mira_1.spoken: Did Lavi tell you? You can hear the Rootways. Wonderful. Can you hear any customers in there?

mira_2.spoken: You woke a whole world? Then it will need shopping. I'm opening a stall there. Possibly. Eventually.

mira_3.spoken: A buried Rootway! Did you find anything shiny down there? Asking for a friend. The friend is me.

mira_4.spoken: Every world open again, and my stall in all of them. Thank you. Truly. Now buy something.

oak_1.spoken: Before the Silence, the roots carried songs between the worlds. Some nights I still hear the echo.

oak_2.spoken: Thornmaw guarded those roots for a hundred years. Thank you for letting it rest gently.

oak_3.spoken: The roots are singing again. I had forgotten how loud joy can be.

bram_1.spoken: You've been to the Inferno. Cold forges, aren't they. I learned to hammer there. It was never cold, back then.

bram_2.spoken: The forges are singing again? Hah! ...Something in my eye. Sparks. It's the sparks.

bram_3.spoken: Vulkhar finally put the hammer down. Good. Pride burns longer than coal, and it gives no heat.

hana_1.spoken: My seeds sprouted this morning! All of them at once! Did you do something? You did something.

hana_2.spoken: The garden is blooming like it remembers how. Come and smell the roses. That's an order.

seren_1.spoken: The Great Silence isn't a sound. It's an absence. Like a word on the tip of your tongue, for a hundred years.

seren_2.spoken: You saw the stars going out. I count them every night. Last night, one fewer.

seren_3.spoken: New stars! Three of them, over the Galaxy. I named one after you. It's the slightly crooked one.

seren_4.spoken: I spent my life trying to understand the Silence. In the end, understanding mattered less than remembering.

kael_1.spoken: You went to the Abyssal Sea. Did you see a lighthouse? ...No. Never mind. Forget I asked.

kael_2.spoken: Someone lit the lighthouse on the Abyssal Sea. Only one person ever knew how. ...I need to sit down.

kael_3.spoken: She came home. She's at the gate every evening, arguing with me about the patrol route. It's wonderful.

pip_1.spoken: Lavi says you can hear the roots! What are they saying? Is it about me?

pip_2.spoken: You beat Thornmaw?! I'm telling everyone. I already told everyone. I'm telling them again.

pip_3.spoken: Take me to a dungeon next time! I'll be so quiet. Watch. ...This is me being quiet.

lulu_1.spoken: The Crystal Realm... I danced at that festival once. I was the best dancer there. Tobi says I fell over. Tobi is wrong.

lulu_2.spoken: The dancers are moving again? Then I'm going back. And this time, I'm not falling over.

tobi_1.spoken: I baked a loaf to celebrate you waking up! It's a little burnt. I baked it a hundred years ago.

tobi_2.spoken: The Inferno's forges are hot again? Perfect oven weather. Could you bring me some of that heat?

tobi_3.spoken: A festival! I'm baking for everyone! I've only burnt three loaves so far. That's a record.

ren_1.spoken: I walked the Rootways, before. Every world had a road home. I'm still looking for mine.

ren_2.spoken: There's a scholar in the Galaxy who works with Seren. Stubborn, short, laughs like my sister. ...I have to go.

ren_3.spoken: I found her. She was there all along, counting stars, waiting for someone to remember her name.

lumi_1.spoken: ...you saw my home. The stars. Were there any left?

lumi_2.spoken: My family's lights are back in the sky. I can see them from the stone lantern. ...Thank you.

vesper_1.spoken: Since the Silence, I see nothing in my crystal ball. It's very relaxing. Terrible for business.

vesper_2.spoken: Ooh. A flicker in the crystal. I see... a word. And you. And quite a lot of trouble. Wonderful!

vesper_3.spoken: My last vision: lanterns, music and a festival in the Plaza. For once, I'm glad to be right.

side_pip_ask.spoken: I found a dragon egg! Well, I lost it. Can you find me a round stone? Break some stone blocks and bring me the roundest one.

side_pip_done.spoken: A dragon egg! ...It's a rock. It's the best rock. I'm going to name it Kevin.

side_hana_ask.spoken: I have one last seed from before the Silence. Plant five seeds for me first, to warm up the soil?

side_hana_done.spoken: The soil is warm. I planted the old seed beside yours. I think it's going to remember how to grow.

side_bram_ask.spoken: I'm forging one perfect blade, but I need to watch a fighter work. Defeat twenty monsters. Anything sharp will do.

side_bram_done.spoken: Good. Every swing told me something. The blade is nearly ready. So are you.

side_tobi_ask.spoken: My grandmother's bread needs Inferno heat. Could you bring me five Magma Shards from the Inferno's monsters?

side_tobi_done.spoken: It's rising! It's golden! It's only a little burnt. Grandmother would be proud.

side_kael_ask.spoken: Take this letter to the Abyssal Sea. Leave it by the water. Don't read it. ...You can read it.

side_kael_done.spoken: You left it by the water? Then she'll know I never stopped waiting. Thank you.

side_lumi_ask.spoken: ...my lantern. I left it in the Galaxy, a hundred years ago. Could you look for it, at night?

side_lumi_done.spoken: You found its light. It was still glowing. It waited for me.

side_lulu_ask.spoken: The festival bell went missing in the Crystal Realm. Without it, nobody knows when to dance. Could you find it?

side_lulu_done.spoken: The bell! Listen to it... Pip, stop ringing it. Pip. Pip!

side_mira_ask.spoken: Someone left a music box with me before the Silence, and it went missing down a dungeon. Any dungeon. It plays a lullaby.

side_mira_done.spoken: My music box! It still plays. It's the song my mother hummed. Don't tell anyone I cried. Here. A discount. A small one.
